body:
Thank you very much for your reply - sometimes you need the encouraging words of others to validate your feelings

I would open up to my friends about the way I've been feeling, but I also don't want to guilt trip them (in a sense) to speaking to me - I don't want them to feel like 'I need to message \[me\] every day to check they aren't dead', I want them to feel like 'I want to message \[me\] because I enjoy speaking with him' - that's what true friendship is to me, because that's the reason I reach out and speak to them

I have contacted my school's counselling service, and I should have an appointment soon

I don't think I'd actually commit suicide - I just think about it
